parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by the frequency of a progressive wave.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: A cathode-ray oscilloscope (c.r.o.) is used to determine the frequency of the sound emitted by a loudspeaker. The trace produced on the screen of the c.r.o. is shown in Fig. 4.1. The time-base setting of the c.r.o. is 250 µs cm^{-1}. Show that the frequency of the sound wave is 1600 Hz.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Determine the speed of the loudspeaker. speed = $\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Describe and explain, qualitatively, the variation in the frequency of the sound heard by the observer.
